name: Troubleshoot software installation and dependency errors
description: Users asked for assistance troubleshooting and resolving errors encountered during the installation, configuration, and removal of software packages, dependencies, and system libraries. The requests focused on fixing specific issues such as missing commands, version incompatibilities, build failures, and missing shared objects across various operating systems and environments.
